title: TRIP-Shapley: Propagation-Aware Contribution Attribution Framework for Peer-to-Peer Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2505.23246v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Contribution attribution is a fundamental problem in federated learning (FL), yet it remains challenging in peer-to-peer FL (P2PFL), where participant influence propagates through repeated model exchanges. Recent work, DICE, addresses this issue by directly tracking multi-round propagation paths. However, its practical deployment is hindered by two challenges: (i) communication explosion caused by multi-hop propagation path tracking, and (ii) vulnerability to misreporting attacks. To overcome these challenges, we consider contribution attribution in P2PFL with a model-free coordinator used solely for auditing. Based on this setting, we propose TRIP-Shapley, a propagation-aware Shapley-inspired surrogate for contribution attribution. Instead of explicitly tracking multi-round paths, TRIP-Shapley computes round-wise contribution scores independently and propagates only scalar contribution values. translated_title: TRIP-Shapley：面向点对点联邦学习的传播感知贡献归因框架
translated_abstract: 贡献归因是联邦学习（FL）中的一个基本问题，但在点对点联邦学习（P2PFL）中依然充满挑战，因为参与者的影响力会通过重复的模型交换而传播。最近的研究DICE通过直接追踪多轮传播路径来解决这一问题。然而，其实际部署受到两大挑战的阻碍：（i）多跳传播路径追踪导致的通信爆炸，（ii）对虚假报告攻击的脆弱性。为了克服这些挑战，我们考虑在点对点联邦学习中采用仅用于审计的无模型协调器来进行贡献归因。基于这一设定，我们提出了TRIP-Shapley，一种传播感知的、受Shapley启发的贡献归因替代方法。TRIP-Shapley不显式追踪多轮路径，而是独立计算每一轮的贡献分数，并仅传播标量形式的贡献值。这使得影响力归因能够……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TRIP-Shapley提出了一种面向点对点联邦学习的传播感知贡献归因框架，通过独立计算每轮贡献分数并仅传播标量贡献值，避免了多跳路径追踪带来的通信爆炸，并能抵御虚假报告攻击。
en_tdlr: TRIP-Shapley is a propagation-aware, Shapley-inspired contribution attribution framework for peer-to-peer federated learning that avoids communication explosion by computing round-wise contributions independently and propagating only scalar values, while remaining robust to misreporting attacks.
